freeze_schema.declared_type_contract: Every declared scalar leaf has its exact Boolean, positive-integer, nonempty-string, digest/OID, UTC-time, null or enum type before semantic comparison; every declared container has its exact object/list type before descent. This is the one-candidate instance of predictions uniquely keyed by candidate_id. M0 is the mandatory effective null baseline and cannot be scored as the microscopic winner.

provenance_protocol.order: custodian commitment issued <= public remote freeze commit/tag < target disclosure <= unchanged frozen scorer execution
provenance_protocol.commitment: Require HMAC-SHA256(K_custodian, domain_separator || 0x00 || RFC8785-JCS(canonical target payload)), with payload schema tect/pre-a-round1-holdout-target-payload/1.0, domain separator TECT-PRE-A-ROUND1-HOLDOUT-TARGET-v1, secret_key_custody=EXTERNAL_CUSTODIAN, and a custodian signature over the commitment metadata. A plain unkeyed hash or author-held key is not accepted.
provenance_protocol.path_policy: Every hash-pinned path must be a normalized relative POSIX path, contain no drive, backslash, absolute prefix, dot segment or parent traversal, and resolve inside the repository. This validator checks the local file hash; the separate remote verifier must bind it to the fetched freeze commit.
provenance_protocol.remote_anchor: Require the public remote commit SHA, remote receipt time, annotated freeze tag freeze/<PRED-ID>/v<N>, tag object ID and custodian signature. The present validator checks only schema shape and local hash pins; a future release verifier must cryptographically validate the signature and independently fetch/verify the remote objects. A local mtime or issued_on field is not temporal evidence.
provenance_protocol.official_record: A future real freeze must use predictions/freezes/<PRED-ID>-freeze.md and a machine sidecar, then receive separate explicit authorization before the annotated git tag is created.
